001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISet;
011import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class PropSubsetEqCard extends Propagator<Variable> {
018
019    private final SetVar sub;
020    private final IntVar subCard;
021    private final SetVar sup;
022    private final IntVar supCard;
023
024    public PropSubsetEqCard(SetVar sub, IntVar subCard, SetVar sup, IntVar supCard) {
025        super(new Variable[]{sub, subCard, sup, supCard}, PropagatorPriority.TERNARY, false);
026        this.sub = sub;
027        this.subCard = subCard;
028        this.sup = sup;
029        this.supCard = supCard;
030    }
031
032    private static int sizeOfIntersection(ISet a, ISet b) {
033        ISetIterator iter = a.iterator();
034        int count = 0;
035        while (iter.hasNext()) {
036            if (b.contains(iter.nextInt())) {
037                count++;
038            }
039        }
040        return count;
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
045        int freeChoice = supCard.getUB() - sup.getLB().size();
046        int intersection = sizeOfIntersection(sub.getUB(), sup.getLB());
047        if (intersection + freeChoice <= subCard.getLB()) {
048            ISetIterator ker = sup.getLB().iterator();
049            while (ker.hasNext()) {
050                int i = ker.nextInt();
051                if (sub.getUB().contains(i)) {
052                    sub.force(i, this);
053                }
054            }
055            ISetIterator env = sup.getUB().iterator();
056            while (env.hasNext()) {
057                int i = env.nextInt();
058                if (!sub.getUB().contains(i) && !sup.getLB().contains(i)) {
059                    sup.remove(i, this);
060                }
061            }
062        }
063
064        int wastedChoice = sup.getLB().size() - intersection;
065        supCard.updateLowerBound(subCard.getLB() + wastedChoice, this);
066        subCard.updateUpperBound(supCard.getUB() - wastedChoice, this);
067
068        if (subCard.getLB() == supCard.getUB()) {
069            PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(sup, sub, this);
070            PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(sup, sub, this);
071        }
072    }
073
074    @Override
075    public ESat isEntailed() {
076        int maxIntersection = sizeOfIntersection(sub.getUB(), sup.getUB());
077        if (maxIntersection < subCard.getLB()) {
078            return ESat.FALSE;
079        }
080        int minIntersection = sizeOfIntersection(sub.getLB(), sup.getLB());
081        int needed = sub.getLB().size() - minIntersection;
082        if (sup.getLB().size() + needed > supCard.getUB()) {
083            return ESat.FALSE;
084        }
085        int intersection = sizeOfIntersection(sub.getUB(), sup.getLB());
086        int wastedChoice = sup.getLB().size() - intersection;
087        if (supCard.getUB() < subCard.getLB() + wastedChoice) {
088            return ESat.FALSE;
089        }
090        if (subCard.getLB() > supCard.getUB()) {
091            return ESat.FALSE;
092        }
093        return ESat.TRUE;
094    }
095}
